title: The Organization dialog
summary: File → Organization… holds the plan, the members with licenses and roles (Owner, Administrator or Member), invitations, groups, the audit and the export, with the trial, credits, files and seats used.
roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

title: Invite a colleague
summary: Invite a person by email with a license; they sign in with that address, accept the invitation and join the organization.
roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

title: Licenses and seats
summary: Each member has one license that caps their roles; Owners and Administrators are told when a license is 80 % and 100 % used.
roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

title: Your organization's plan: Editor Basic or Editor Pro
summary: The plan belongs to the organization: in a Standard organization every Editor is Editor Basic, in a Professional, University or Enterprise one every Editor is Editor Pro; the Owner upgrades Standard to Professional.
roles: Everyone sees the plan; the Owner (Manage billing) upgrades

title: Pro features in an Editor Basic organization
summary: With Editor Basic the Editor Pro features stay on screen, greyed out with Pro; pressing one says why, with See plans and, for the Owner, Upgrade.
roles: Everyone in a Standard organization

title: University organizations: the term, Reviewers and Viewers
summary: A University organization has Editor Pro free for 3 months, renewed each term, one free Reviewer per Editor and unlimited free Viewers; after the term it is read-only until it is renewed.
roles: Teachers and students in a University organization

title: Organization roles and the passkey rule
summary: Organization roles and why Owner, Administrator and Project administrator take effect only after you add a passkey; confirming it is you.
roles: Everyone, for their own account

title: Who administers the organization
summary: The person who starts the organization is its first Owner; an Owner makes others Owner or Administrator, and LANXTOR can set them when the company names someone else.
roles: Owner (Owner role); Owner or Administrator (Administrator and Member)

title: Requests to join from your company's domain
summary: Colleagues with your company's email address who sign in ask to join your organization; an Owner or Administrator approves or declines.
roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

title: Project members and roles
summary: Give a person or group a role on a project in its Members dialog: Project administrator, Lead engineer, Engineer, Reviewer or Viewer.
roles: Project administrator with a passkey

title: Roles on a single drawing: Share and Mark as read-only
summary: Give someone a role on one 2D space only, or keep a finished 2D space from being changed.
roles: Project administrator

title: Why a change is refused
summary: A refusal names the missing permission, where it was needed and whether the role, the license, a passkey or an ended trial is the reason.
roles: Everyone

title: Groups
summary: Collect people in a group to give them a role together.
roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

title: Who sees what: reviewers and viewers
summary: Hide a project from viewers or reviewers, and an attribute on its class or on one object; the built-in groups Reviewers and Viewers decide who is who.
roles: Owners and Administrators (groups, Project settings, Configuration); editors with Edit attributes (one object)

title: Audit: what administrators and Alex did
summary: The Audit tab lists the organization's important events and what was sent to an AI model.
roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

title: Export everything of the organization
summary: An Owner downloads the whole organization in one archive after confirming it is them with a passkey.
roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

title: Trials and the read-only lock
summary: An organization of your own, usually for 30 days (LANXTOR can choose another length or change it while it runs); afterwards it is read-only and can still be viewed and exported.
roles: Everyone in the trial organization

title: Blocked email domains
summary: Personal email providers (Gmail, Outlook.com, Yahoo …) and some company domains cannot be given E1; LANXTOR keeps the list and can allow one person as an exception.
roles: Applies to everyone; kept by LANXTOR

title: Permission categories and custom roles
summary: Every permission in plain words by category and level, and roles of your own given like built-in ones.
roles: Owner or Administrator

title: Assign to…: objects a person or group is responsible for
summary: Make a person or group responsible for an object, folder, sheet or section: only they change it and everything in it; everyone else still views and comments.
roles: Engineer and above; Project administrator to reassign

title: Access history and audit export
summary: Every change to members, licenses, groups, roles and responsibilities with before and after, access on any earlier date, exports to Excel and CSV, access reviews and emergency access.
roles: Owner or Administrator

training.topic: Access history, reviews and emergency access

title: Show groups instead of names in history
summary: Configuration → Privacy chooses whether history shows the names of the people who made each change or only the groups they are in, for companies whose privacy rules do not allow names.
roles: Reading: everyone. Changing: Owner or Administrator with a passkey (manage the organization's policies)

title: Company single sign-on and directory sync
summary: Your people sign in with your company's own sign-in (OpenID Connect: Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, …), optionally only that way, and your directory keeps members, groups and licenses up to date (SCIM).
roles: Owners and Administrators (Manage sign-on), with your IT; LANXTOR verifies your email domains

title: Tokens, service accounts and agents
summary: Access tokens for scripts and other systems, service accounts with their own roles and tokens, and the versioned API (/api/v1) with its OpenAPI description.
roles: Everyone with an Editor license makes their own tokens; Owners and Administrators manage service accounts

training.topic: Tokens, service accounts and the API

title: Webhooks and the change feed
summary: Tell another system at once when something changes in E1 (webhooks, signed and retried), or let it ask what changed since it last looked (the change feed of the API).
roles: Owners and Administrators (Manage connections) set up webhooks; anyone who sees a project may read its change feed with a token

title: Discipline permissions, four-eyes approval and support access
summary: Planned: roles limited to one discipline, a second approver on merge requests, and time-limited support access.
roles: Not yet decided
